title: What If You Only Slept 4 Hours a Night? 😴 #shorts
description:
Would you trade sleep for 28 extra hours a week? Yes or no?
In a 2-week study, 4-hour sleepers got as slow as people awake for 2 days straight, and barely noticed.

Sources: Van Dongen et al., Sleep 2003 (via Science News), CDC YRBS 2025, American Academy of Sleep Medicine (via CDC / Sleep Foundation)
